name: Charizard-Gmax
prompt: Draw a transparent pixel-art animation atlas for Charizard-Gmax. Use the reference only for exact character identity, native colours and views. EXACT FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS,16 full-body sprites separated by wide empty transparent gutters. Each row keeps its camera throughout: FRONT, RIGHT PROFILE, REAR, LEFT PROFILE. Column1 startled wince with braced body; column2 stronger wince with head lowered; column3 body settles low and limbs fold; column4 body rests completely on the ground with closed eyes, limbs relaxed. Keep the rear view strictly posterior when lying down, showing back and hidden face. Actual newly drawn poses, expressive body articulation, consistent pixel scale, all native markings, accessories and anatomy. Crisp pixels, limited original palette. No text, detached effects, shadows or scenery.

review.scope: Independent visual review, normal and shiny separately; exact PNG hashes checked

shiny_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Recolour the sixteen sprites of image1 to match the exact native SHINY colours of image2. Keep all16 poses, fourcolumns/fourrows, exact grid, fixed FRONT/RIGHT/REAR/LEFT camera per row, pixel scale, anatomy and parts. Transparent background/gutters, crisp pixels, no added objects/effects/text. The dragon SKIN is uniform native MUTED PURPLE/DARK VIOLET with smooth coherent pixel shading, including thighs, knees, hips, shoulders, arms, back joints, tail base and snout. Remove every orange/yellow fire ring or stripe from the SKIN: the skin does not have glowing fire patterns. Only the ACTUAL FLAMES above the shoulders and tail tip stay orange/yellow; chest white, original golden belly emblem and pink clouds remain distinct. Preserve exact native skin/flame boundaries.
